card.desc: A spell released. Designed, not recorded - shimmer with a body under it.
card.prompt: a magical spell casting whoosh, shimmering bell-like sparkle with a low whoosh underneath, designed sound effect, dry
card.negative: music, melody, speech, reverb, explosion, crowd, repeating
card.note: Sparkle alone is thin; the low whoosh is what gives it a body. Layer over impact_hit for a big one.

peak_limited.why: audition copy had no peak ceiling; the film bus already limits to -3 dBTP
